name: 2D Object Matching and Supervision
aliases: 2D Object Matching and Supervision — Hungarian Algorithm Association, sIoU/CES Cost Calculation
definition: A method to associate predicted 2D object masks with ground truth 2D object masks using the Hungarian algorithm based on Soft Intersection-over-Union (sIoU) and Cross-Entropy Score (CES) costs, enabling supervision for object decomposition.
